descriptions.short: Boise Construction Co builds homes in the Treasure Valley, with custom, semi-custom, and build-on-your-lot services.
descriptions.long: Boise Construction Co is a DBA of P5 Home Co LLC, based in Meridian, Idaho and serving the Treasure Valley. Services include custom and semi-custom homes, build-on-your-lot construction, design-build, home additions, lot feasibility, shop homes and energy-efficient homes. Project scope, feasibility, pricing and availability require individual review.
